name: Trace a runtime error
short_description: Use an error message and execution context to locate the responsible statement in a small program.
self_assessment: I can trace one runtime error to its responsible statement without help.
description: Use an error message and execution context to locate the responsible statement in a small program. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Locate a failed conversion from a stack trace
